method.method_draft: First inspect the scatter plot: the data points do not follow a straight-line pattern; they show a curved, roughly quadratic/parabolic relationship in the y-values. Then read the question, which asks specifically what transformation should be applied to each data point's y-value so the transformed data are suitable for linear regression. Use the linearization rule that if a response variable appears to vary quadratically, i.e. y behaves like the square of a linear quantity, then plotting sqrt(y) against x can make the relationship approximately linear. Therefore transform each y-value by taking its square root.
